ko.executive_summary: Silicon photonics is accelerating adoption for AI cluster connectivity, with multiple vendors advancing high-speed optical interconnect solutions. Key developments include NVIDIA/Cisco introducing new pluggable optics form factors, Intel claiming sole 300mm InP wafer production capacity, and silicon photonics chips reaching 3.2 Tbps for AI data traffic, while Linktel demonstrated 1.6T LPO performance at OCP 2026.
key_facts: Silicon photonics chip achieves 3.2 Terabits Per Second
NVIDIA and Cisco introduced new pluggable optics form factor
Intel claims to be sole volume producer of 300mm Indium Phosphide wafers
Linktel Technologies demonstrated 1.6T LPO performance at OCP 2026
GlobalFoundries expands US chip investment to $5 billion
Infineon signs 200mm SiC wafer supply deal with Wolfspeed

implications.text: Silicon photonics maturation is directly enabling large-scale AI cluster deployments through improved optical interconnect speeds and form factors
Intel's claimed monopoly on 300mm InP wafer production and Infineon's SiC supply agreements underscore critical bottlenecks in optical transceiver manufacturing capacity
NVIDIA/Cisco's new pluggable optics form factor and Linktel's LPO solutions suggest industry movement toward standardized interfaces for AI optical interconnects
Multiple vendors (Intel, Linktel, NVIDIA/Cisco) simultaneously advancing 1.6T-3.2T solutions indicates accelerating competition in AI optical transceiver market

ko.counterpoint: GlobalFoundries and TeraNova leadership announcements are tangential to core CPO/optical optics technology advancement and may reflect broader capex cycles rather than sector-specific innovation.
